reason: I'd maybe post on the free staff board since I'm two waiters short, but I already have a POS and a QR menu on the tables, and I'm not adding another QR system and another fee while I'm running the floor myself. The free three months just means I'd have to deal with cancelling it later.
objection: Two QR codes on one table confuses guests, and my staff would have to learn how this one works next to the POS and the card terminal, plus the payment partner's fee goes on top of 59 lari every month.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into my existing POS and QR menu so there is nothing new for staff, and I could see it actually brings regulars back more than my Instagram does.
